verify_detail: ly deterministic app behavior tied to a stored launch-count value that cycles mod 5 and intentionally suppresses the Retry-sync button (rendering "Sync unavailable" with no button at all) on 2 of every 5 app starts. A UI test that asserts the button is always visible on a cold launch will fail whenever the persisted counter lands on remainder 2 or 4 — the test needs to either reset/control that counter before asserting, or account for the "Sync unavailable" (no-button) state as a valid outcome.'
